description: This file defines CPU feature detection for ARM64 architecture on Linux, including hardware capability bits, kernel version checks, and feature initialization functions.

methods.name: linuxKernelCanEmulateCPUID
methods.description: Checks if the Linux kernel version is 4.11+ to determine if CPUID can be emulated.

methods.name: doinit
methods.description: Initializes CPU feature flags based on hardware capabilities and kernel version.

methods.name: isSet
methods.description: Helper function to check if a specific hardware capability bit is set.
